claims.text: He was Vice Chairman of the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics. The Committee's Fortieth Annual Report records that on 22 October 1954 Jerome C. Hunsaker was re-elected chairman and 'Dr. Detlev W. Bronk vice chairman of the NACA', and lists him in the membership as President of the Rockefeller Institute for Medical Research.

claims.sourceText: Fortieth Annual Report of the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics, 1954, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19930092186/downloads/19930092186.pdf
claims.text: NACA membership was a Presidential appointment and unpaid. The same report states that the members of the Committee 'are appointed by the President and serve as such without compensation', and that the seat formerly held ex officio by the chairman of the Research and Development Board was replaced by a Department of Defense representative after that Board's abolition under Reorganization Plan No. 6, effective 30 June 1953.
